items.name: color-picker

items.title: Tour
items.description: Onboarding tour that dims the page and cuts a rounded spotlight around each target, gliding and resizing it from step to step, with a card that flips and shifts to stay in the viewport, a gliding progress dot, Back/Next/Skip/Done, targets scrolled into view, Escape to close, trapped focus that returns to the trigger, controlled/uncontrolled open and step, and reduced-motion safe.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group

items.name: dropdown-menu

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Hover card that springs out of its trigger after an open delay and stays open while the pointer travels into it; also opens on keyboard focus, closes on Escape or blur, and flips and aligns on any side to stay in the viewport, while touch taps simply follow the link.

items.name: kbd

items.name: alert

items.name: skeleton

items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input

items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Desktop-app menubar (File / Edit / View) on the WAI-ARIA menubar pattern where every menu renders into one shared floating panel, so once a menu is open hovering another title or pressing Left/Right switches instantly while the panel glides and resizes to fit, with Kbd shortcuts, checkbox and radio rows, separators, disabled items, hover-intent submenus, typeahead and a spring-gliding active row.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: General-purpose badge in default, secondary, outline, destructive, success and warning (soft or solid), three sizes, with an optional pulsing status dot or icon, removable filter chips whose x plays an exit before onRemove while siblings glide into the gap, and a count mode whose digits roll in the direction of change and cap at 99+ (complements AnimatedBadge, which animates status transitions).
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Multi-step flow with an active ring that glides between step markers, connectors that fill as steps complete, panels that slide in from the direction of travel while the container morphs to each panel's height, and an async per-step guard that shakes the marker when it refuses. Linear or free navigation, controlled/uncontrolled, reduced-motion safe.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker Date Picker
items.description: Date field whose calendar morphs open from the trigger corner and closes on pick.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: calendar
items.title: Date Picker Calendar
items.description: Inline single-date calendar; the selected pill glides between days. Weekends disabled in this demo.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Picker Date Range Picker
items.description: Range field whose two-month calendar morphs open beside one-click presets and commits once the end day is picked.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: booking-calendar
items.title: Date Picker Booking Calendar
items.description: Two-month stay picker with nightly prices under each day and the cheapest days tinted, booked nights struck through, a minimum stay, and a footer with dates, nights, total and a Reserve button.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Date Picker Time Picker
items.description: iOS-style hour, minute and AM/PM drums composed from WheelPicker, inline or as a time field whose wheels morph open and commit on Done.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: date-time-picker
items.title: Date Picker Date & Time Picker
items.description: One field whose panel morphs open with the calendar beside time wheels; edits a draft and commits on Done, labelled like "Oct 14, 2026, 9:30 AM".
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: month-picker
items.title: Date Picker Month Picker
items.description: Twelve-month grid with a gliding selection pill, year slides and a zoom-out year grid, single or range mode, min/max and full keyboard navigation, plus a popover month field.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: table
items.title: Table Data Table
items.description: 10k virtualized rows with sortable headers, row selection, column resize and reorder.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: table-editable
items.title: Table Editable Table
items.description: Edit cells inline and insert or delete rows and columns via border handles; the table re-renders from the updated data and column defs.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: table-async
items.title: Table Async Table
items.description: Loads pages on demand — skeleton rows on first load, then infinite scroll via onEndReached as the virtualized list nears the bottom.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: table-advanced
items.title: Table Advanced Data Table
items.description: Paginated DataTable with multi-column sort (Shift+click adds keys, rows glide into place), per-column text/select filters and global search, column hide and drag or keyboard reorder, expandable detail rows and Shift-range selection with a selected-count bar.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: shader-background
items.title: Shader Background
items.description: Canvas shader backgrounds (mesh gradient, grain, warp, waves, voronoi, dot orbit and more) with a single typed variant prop. Reduced-motion freezes animated variants.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: cylinder-carousel
items.title: Cylinder Carousel
items.description: A carousel whose items line the inside of a cylinder, receding into the center and growing toward the edges. Drag, scroll or arrow-key to roll it, with a springy glide and snap. Reduced-motion drops the glide.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Loading indicator with seventeen variants: spinner, dots, bars, dot-matrix, dither, morph, comet, scramble, metaballs, newton, helix, percent, and five terminal-style ascii spinners. Scales from one size prop, uses currentColor, and reduced-motion swaps every transform for a calm opacity pulse.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: voice-input
items.title: Voice Input
items.description: A mic button that morphs into a recording pill with a live Web Audio waveform, elapsed timer, cancel and confirm actions, a shimmering transcription state, and graceful permission-denied fallback.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, grouped messages, expandable content, and interactive link or button support.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Composable conversation primitives for message rows, grouped bubbles, avatars, metadata, live markers, and a mount-only trailing-edge pop-up for newly sent rows.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A reader-aware conversation viewport that follows streamed output at the live edge and releases control when the reader moves away.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: An auto-growing agent composer with prompt actions, model selection, keyboard submission, and animated send and stop states.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: todo-list
items.title: Todo List
items.description: A collapsible agent task plan with morphing status marks, a completion count, compact metadata, and smooth list updates.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A syntax-highlighted code surface with stable streaming updates, line numbers, focused lines, smooth following, and copy feedback.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: A human-in-the-loop decision surface for approvals, single or multiple-choice questions, custom responses, and multi-step review flows.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File Diff
items.description: A syntax-highlighted file change disclosure with progressive rows, line numbers, live change counts, smooth following, and completion collapse.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: tool-result
items.title: Tool Result
items.description: A lightweight execution disclosure for syntax-highlighted terminal output and request responses that collapses into a compact completed state.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming Response
items.description: A stable response surface with completion actions, rendered content, and an expandable source summary.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image Generation
items.description: A stable generated-image surface that moves from queued work through progressive refinement to a completed result without layout shift.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: A human-in-the-loop permission card for reviewing tool details, allowing once, remembering access, or denying execution.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline citation markers paired with a collapsible, progressively rendered reference collection for grounded agent responses.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: agent-activity
items.title: Agent Activity
items.description: One adaptive activity stream for reasoning, searches, tool calls, structured execution traces, or a chronological mix.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: reasoning-text
items.title: Agent Loading States Reasoning Text
items.description: Shimmering reasoning copy with an ASCII loader and cascade, phrase-swap, or per-letter scramble transitions.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: thinking-shimmer
items.title: Agent Loading States Thinking Shimmer
items.description: A quiet shimmer that keeps the agent's current status readable while work continues.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: agent-progress
items.title: Agent Loading States Agent Progress
items.description: A compact activity glyph, action verb, and live tabular timer for longer-running agent work.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model Selector
items.description: Searchable AI model picker (`ModelSelector`) that morphs open from its trigger with models grouped by provider, generic geometric provider glyphs, vision/tools/reasoning/fast capability badges, context size, relative cost dots, a New tag and a gliding active row with full keyboard navigation; a richer standalone alternative to PromptInput's compact model select, controlled or uncontrolled.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: context-meter
items.title: Context Meter
items.description: Token usage indicator (`ContextMeter`) whose compact ring and "42k / 200k" readout expand on hover or click into a breakdown bar of system, conversation, files and tool segments in chart colors, turning warning then critical near the limit and offering an async "Compact conversation" action; drops into PromptInput's `leadingAction` slot.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt Suggestions
items.description: Suggested prompt cards or chips (`PromptSuggestions`) that stagger in on first reveal, filter and highlight as the composer text changes via `query`, reflow with spring layout, move with arrow keys and hand the chosen prompt to `onSelect` — built for empty-chat welcome screens above a PromptInput.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message Actions
items.description: Assistant message action row (`MessageActions`) with copy that morphs into a drawn check, regenerate that spins (continuously while its promise runs), exclusive thumbs up/down that pop in filled, a thumbs-down reason popover with toggle chips and comment, share and a more menu; reveals on message hover or focus and stays visible on touch or with `visibility="always"` for the last message — a standalone, richer counterpart to StreamingResponse's built-in actions.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: branch-navigator
items.title: Branch Navigator
items.description: Version switcher for regenerated or edited messages: `Branches` shares a controlled or uncontrolled index, `BranchContent` cross-fades and slides the active version in from the direction you navigated, and `BranchNavigator` renders a "‹ 2 / 3 ›" control with a rolling counter, arrow/Home/End keys and live announcements, usable standalone too.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: conversation-history
items.title: Conversation History
items.description: Chat history sidebar list grouped into Pinned, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days and Older from a now read after mount, with search, a spring-gliding active highlight, hover or focus row actions to pin, rename in place through InlineEdit and delete with a slide-out exit while neighbours glide up, and new chats that drop in at the top with a streaming title caret.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: artifact-panel
items.title: Artifact Panel
items.description: Side canvas that slides open beside a chat (its width eases so the conversation reflows smoothly) to show a generated artifact, with a version switcher whose label rolls by direction, Preview/Code tabs rendering code through CodeBlock, copy, download and close actions, a shared-layout expand into a fullscreen overlay, cross-fading content between versions and a skeleton while a new version generates.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice Orb
items.description: Audio-reactive orb for voice mode whose blurred --chart and --primary color blobs orbit inside a glossy sphere and swell with a 0..1 level prop, easing between idle breathing, listening ripples, a circling thinking arc and churning speaking motion, with a simulate mode that synthesizes speech-like levels and a gentle opacity pulse under reduced motion; pairs with VoiceInput for capture.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: ai-sidebar
items.title: AI Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible AI workspace sidebar for folders, projects, files, and bookmarks with keyboard navigation, optimistic moves, inline rename, and overflow-aware labels.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: chat-app
items.title: Chat App
items.description: A complete agent conversation workspace composing navigation, messages, streaming, planning, approvals, tools, code, diffs, generated media, sources, and prompt input.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: inbox-app
items.title: Inbox App
items.description: Mail client with a folder rail and unread counts (virtual folders like Starred via `filter`), a searchable message list with unread dots, stars, checkboxes and a gliding selection highlight, a reading pane that cross-fades between messages, and swipe-right-to-archive / swipe-left-to-delete rows that slide out with an Undo bar.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: music-player
items.title: Music Player
items.description: Now-playing card with a token-gradient cover that breathes with playback, title and artist that cross-fade in the skip direction, a draggable scrub bar with buffered and played layers, play/pause icon swap, shuffle and repeat-all/one toggles, volume slider with mute, and a queue drawer that slides up over the card; playback is simulated unless a track has a `src`.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: file-manager
items.title: File Manager
items.description: File browser with breadcrumb navigation, folders that slide in from the side you travel, grid/list views, click / Cmd-Ctrl-click / Shift-click range selection with arrow-key movement, kind-tinted file icons, a sort menu, a storage usage meter, and a drop overlay that adds dragged-in files to the open folder.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell
items.description: Container-sized app shell whose sidebar collapses to icons with tooltips and a gliding active pill, a top bar with a Mod+K search field and avatar menu, and a content slot with breadcrumbs, title and actions that cross-fades per page; below its own `mobileBelow` width (768px default) the sidebar moves into a Drawer — a data-driven complement to the viewport-height AnimatedSidebar primitives.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: Plan comparison grid with a monthly/yearly switch that rolls every price, plan columns in a sticky header over scrolling feature rows, collapsible feature groups, check / dash / partial / text cells, a recommended column tinted top to bottom, and a plan switcher with one cross-fading column in narrow containers — the detailed companion to PricingTable.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: feature-section
items.title: Feature Section
items.description: Marketing features section with a vertical tab list beside a visual panel that cross-fades and slides in the direction of travel to each feature's visual, autoplay that fills a progress rail on the active row and advances, pausing on hover or focus, with a pause button and keyboard tabs.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: blog-list
items.title: Blog List
items.description: Blog index with category chips and a gliding pill, a wide featured post, and cards with gradient or image covers, excerpt, author avatar, read time and an en-US date that lift on hover; filtering reflows the grid with shared layout and Load more appends the next page with a stagger, falling back to `onLoadMore` for server pagination.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: status-page
items.title: Status Page
items.description: Service status block with an overall banner derived from today's worst status, per-service 90-day uptime bars that grow in on view and reveal a date, status and incident tooltip on hover or arrow-key focus, computed uptime percentages, and an incident timeline whose entries expand into their update history, all formatted in UTC from deterministic data.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: changelog
items.title: Changelog
items.description: Release notes list with a version and date rail, New/Improved/Fixed badges, entries that expand to reveal their staggered change lines, a tag filter with counts that reflows the list with layout animation, and an email subscribe field driven by a StatefulButton promise.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: roadmap
items.title: Roadmap
items.description: Public product roadmap with Planned, In progress and Shipped columns or a quarter timeline, where cards fly between the two views through shared layout, re-sort by votes as you upvote with a direction-aware rolling count, carry tag badges, and can be filtered by status.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: Sign-in card that pairs with Signup Form — email, password and remember-me with generic SSO/passkey buttons — whose "Forgot password?" flow morphs inside the same card from requesting a code to a check-your-inbox screen with a resend cooldown, then an OTP plus new-password step and a drawn success check, with every async handler driving pending states and shaking the card on rejection.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: Account settings with a side nav whose pill glides between Profile, Notifications, Appearance and Billing, sections built from inline edits, switches, selects, toggle groups and usage bars, a draft that slides up a sticky unsaved-changes bar with Reset and an async Save that shakes on failure, and a danger zone behind a type-to-confirm dialog.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: Contact section with name, email, a topic select and an auto-growing message textarea with a live character counter, validation that only flags fields after blur, an async submit that shakes on error and morphs the card into a drawn-check thank-you panel, plus a side panel of contact methods.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Checkout flow on Stepper — shipping with a gliding delivery-speed choice, display-only payment fields and an editable review — beside an order summary with compact quantity steppers, a promo code that shakes when invalid and pops a removable badge when valid, and subtotal, discount, tax and total that roll on every change.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: invoice
items.title: Invoice
items.description: Printable invoice with number and UTC-formatted dates, an animated Paid / Due / Overdue status badge, bill-from and bill-to, a staggered line-item table and subtotal, tax and total, plus Download, Send and Mark-as-paid actions that stamp the sheet and roll the amount due to zero, with print variants that hide the actions and switch to ink-friendly colors.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: Getting-started card with a progress ring and bar and steps that expand to a description and an async CTA; finishing a step pops its check, strikes its title and opens the next unfinished step, and at 100% the list gives way to a confetti celebration, with a dismiss that animates the card away.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: cta-section
items.title: CTA Section
items.description: Closing call-to-action section in a centered layout (large headline, two CTAs and a reassurance checklist inside a card) or a split layout (copy beside a visual or an email capture with a stateful submit), with a word-by-word headline reveal on scroll, a rotating gradient beam on the card border or a soft dotted field, and a layout that adapts to its own container width.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Trusted-by logo strip with an infinite marquee variant behind edge fade masks that pauses on hover or focus, and a grid variant whose logos fade in with a stagger and lift on hover; logos start muted and grayscale and take their own colors on hover, accept any SVG or node, and fall back to a static row under reduced motion.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: how-it-works
items.title: How It Works
items.description: Numbered steps section whose connector draws from marker to marker as it scrolls into view, lighting each marker as the line arrives; horizontal on wide containers and a vertical timeline on narrow ones, with optional per-step media that cross-fades when a step is hovered, focused or chosen with arrow keys like a tab.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: integrations-section
items.title: Integrations Section
items.description: Integrations showcase pairing a hub-and-spoke orbit (your logo at the center, integration icons on counter-rotating rings that keep icons upright and pause on hover) with a searchable card grid filtered by category chips behind a gliding pill, where cards enter, leave and reflow with spring layout animation.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: image-gallery
items.title: Image Gallery
items.description: Photo gallery laid out as a masonry or uniform grid sized by its own container width, with hover zoom and caption reveal, category filters behind a gliding chip with spring layout reflow, and a lightbox that grows out of the clicked tile with prev/next, arrow keys, Escape, swipe, a counter and a focus trap; reduced motion turns every move into a fade.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: newsletter-section
items.title: Newsletter Section
items.description: Newsletter signup section with an email field, light validation and a submit button that steps through idle, loading, success and error from your onSubscribe promise, a form that morphs into a confirmation with a draw-in check, a privacy note, optional reader avatars for social proof, and card or inline layouts.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: team-section
items.title: Team Section
items.description: Team page section with member cards that stagger in on view and slide up a bio and links on hover or focus, department filter chips with a gliding pill and spring layout reflow, and a click that opens a focus-managed dialog with the member's full bio, location and links.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: content-section
items.title: Content Section
items.description: Long-form marketing content block in three variants: split copy beside media that stays pinned while paragraphs scroll, a stats layout whose callouts roll their numbers up on view, and a pull quote framed by large typographic quote marks, with paragraphs revealed as they scroll into view.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: audit-trail
items.title: Audit Trail
items.description: Chronological activity log grouped by day with actor avatars, verb-plus-target summaries, relative times, severity and category badges, actor, action-type and search filters, entries that expand into a before/after field diff, new events sliding in at the top, and an export hook that receives the filtered rows.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: approval-queue
items.title: Approval Queue
items.description: Review queue for pending expense, access, deploy and time-off requests with row and bulk selection, approve and reject that swipe rows out optimistically with an undo toast, a dialog that asks for a rejection reason, Pending/Approved/Rejected tabs whose counts roll, and j/k/x/a/r keyboard shortcuts.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: log-explorer
items.title: Log Explorer
items.description: Log stream viewer with a volume histogram you click or drag across to narrow the time window, level filters, a text query with highlighted matches, a virtualized monospace table, live tail that follows new lines until you scroll up and then shows a Jump to latest pill, and a side panel with each line's structured fields as JSON.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: performance-report
items.title: Performance Report
items.description: Dashboard report with a date range picker and previous-period compare switch, rolling KPI cards with delta badges, an area trend chart that adds the previous period as a muted series, a breakdown table with inline growing bars, and auto-generated highlights that stagger in, with skeletons holding the layout while a new range loads.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie Consent
items.description: Cookie consent card that springs up after mount with Accept all, Reject non-essential and Customize, where Customize grows the card into Necessary (locked on), Analytics and Marketing switches with Save; the choice is reported through onConsentChange and can persist to localStorage, anchored bottom-left, bottom or bottom-right, fixed to the viewport or contained in a parent.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navbar with a logo slot, plain links and mega-menu panels: a hover pill glides between items, the dropdown viewport morphs its size to each panel while content slides in the direction you move, panels open on hover intent or click/Enter, close on Escape or outside click, support arrow-key navigation, and collapse below md into a hamburger sheet with accordion sections.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Bento layout of feature tiles on a container-query grid that collapses to one column in narrow containers, with per-card column and row spans, icon, title, description and a visual slot that lifts and zooms on hover, a radial spotlight that follows the cursor across the border and surface, a CTA whose arrow nudges on hover, and cards that stagger in when scrolled into view.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: KPI tiles whose headline numbers roll digit by digit to each new value, with Intl number, currency, percent and compact formatting, a delta badge with an up or down arrow toned by whether the move is good news, an inline sparkline that redraws when its data changes, a period caption, a skeleton loading state and a container-query StatGrid layout.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: Bell trigger whose unread badge springs when the count rises, opening a panel that grows out of the bell with All/Unread tabs and a gliding indicator, Today/Earlier groups, relative times, unread dots, hover actions to mark read or archive that collapse rows out while the rest glide up, Mark all as read, an empty state, focus management with Escape, and a controlled or uncontrolled notifications list.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ Section
items.description: FAQ page section with an eyebrow, heading and description column beside an accordion that opens one or many answers with height-morphing panels and a rotating plus, an optional search that narrows questions with spring layout reflow and highlights matches, a Still have questions CTA slot, optional hash deep links, and a layout that splits into two columns based on its own container width.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: testimonial-wall
items.title: Testimonial Wall
items.description: Testimonial wall of quote cards with names, roles, initials avatars and optional star ratings, laid out in masonry-like columns that scroll vertically in alternating directions behind fade masks, pause on hover or focus, fall back to a static masonry under reduced motion, offer a static grid variant, and pick their column count from the block's own container width.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: Landing hero with a New pill badge, a headline revealed word by word with a spring blur-in, supporting copy that follows, primary and secondary CTAs, an install command chip with an animated copy button, an optional media slot that tilts up into place on view, and a CSS-gradient grid background with sweeping beams, centered or left aligned.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: footer-section
items.title: Footer Section
items.description: Site footer with a brand column of logo, tagline and social icons that lift on hover, link columns that collapse into disclosures in narrow containers, a newsletter signup that validates email and runs idle, loading, success and error states from an onSubscribe promise, and a bottom bar with legal links and a theme toggle slot.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event Calendar
items.description: Month and week event calendar: month cells pack events into lanes so multi-day events become bars across the week row and overflowing days open a "+N more" list, while week view places timed events on an hour grid, side by side where they overlap, with a live now line and optional 15-minute drag to reschedule. Periods slide in from the direction you travel, the Month/Week switcher pill glides between views, and day cells support arrow-key navigation.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Pricing block with a monthly/yearly toggle whose pill glides between options beside a Save 20% badge, prices that roll digit by digit to the new period, three plans with a highlighted Popular card, feature lists with check and cross rows, per-plan CTA buttons, Intl currency formatting and cards that stack based on their own container width.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Task board whose cards drag within and across columns, opening a dashed drop slot where they will land, lighting up the column underneath and flying into place via shared layout. Space, arrows and Escape move cards from the keyboard with live announcements. Columns show count badges, cards carry tags, assignee initials and a priority dot, and on mobile the columns scroll horizontally with snap. Controlled/uncontrolled, reduced-motion safe.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: infinite-masonry
items.title: Infinite Masonry
items.description: Responsive virtualized masonry that measures variable-height cards and loads more data as the user nears the end.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: Compact notification cards that spring from a stacked summary into a readable list on hover, focus or tap.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: project-folder
items.title: Project Folder
items.description: An interactive project folder that opens its file fan on hover or focus, expands into a focus-managed overlay, then retraces the complete path when closed.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: knockout-wheel
items.title: Fixtures Knockout Wheel
items.description: The tournament drawn radially. The champion holds the hub, each round is a ring further out, and the teams themselves form the rim. Nodes spring in ring by ring, and hovering one isolates that team while the rest recede. Teams show a flag, a logo or their initials, and a deeper draw grows another ring.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: knockout-bracket
items.title: Fixtures Knockout Bracket
items.description: Pages one round at a time. The leftmost round stacks at a fixed rhythm, each later round centers between its two feeder matches, and cards, elbow connectors, headers and stage height animate into every new layout. A third place play-off sits below the tree under its own rule. Round names, team artwork, dates and result chips all come from the data you pass.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: availability-scheduler
items.title: Availability Scheduler
items.description: Weekly availability editor where each day springs between available and unavailable, time ranges add and remove with blur-slide motion, times pick from a scrollable dropdown, and a copy menu clones hours to other days.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: swap
items.title: Multi-chain Swap
items.description: Cross-chain swap widget with chain + token selectors, morphing views, animated flip and quote.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: iOS-style island pill that morphs between live activity views with bouncy shell resize and blur crossfades.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K palette with fuzzy filter, spring-animated active row and glass surface.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: morphing-search
items.title: Morphing Search
items.description: Search field or compact icon that morphs into a glass results surface, whether opened by click or keyboard shortcut.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: expandable-action-bar
items.title: Expandable Action Bar
items.description: Compact icon actions that expand into labeled controls on hover or focus with shared layout motion.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: overflow-actions
items.title: Overflow Actions
items.description: Connected pill rail for primary actions that springs open to reveal extra controls.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: expandable-tabs
items.title: Expandable Tabs
items.description: Icon tab bar where the active tab expands to a labelled pill, with a panel above that morphs height and slides content direction-aware on switch.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: morphing-tabs
items.title: Morphing Tabs
items.description: Reorderable tabs whose selected item grows into a white content surface, with the active shape gliding as tabs move and a shared morph between rooms.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: swipeable-list
items.title: Swipeable List
items.description: Mobile-style list rows that swipe left or right to reveal contextual action buttons.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: attachment-upload
items.title: File Upload Attachment Upload
items.description: A mixed attachment workspace with a dropzone, staggered file and image rows, animated upload, success, failure, retry and removal feedback, shared-layout image previews, and an audio waveform.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload Upload Queue
items.description: A drag-and-drop upload queue with progress rows, upload states, retry, and removal.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: prediction-market
items.title: Prediction Market
items.description: Prediction market trade ticket with buy/sell modes, outcome prices, rolling amount entry, quick add chips and trade states.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: wallet-card
items.title: Wallet Card
items.description: Wallet overview card with an account switcher and search that morph open from their triggers, a cascading balance with a live change pill and privacy toggle, copy-address, and Send / Deposit / Swap / Buy actions.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code input with a gliding focus ring, digits that roll in per slot, error shake and a success check draw.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Sign Up Form
items.description: Composed sign-up form that flags a field only once it is left, then clears the moment it is fixed, with a length-weighted strength meter, password reveal and an animated submit lifecycle.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: bloom-menu
items.title: Bloom Menu
items.description: A button that morphs open into a menu and blooms iris-out from the center, the grid revealing in every direction with radially staggered items.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: feedback-widget
items.title: Feedback Widget
items.description: Corner trigger that morphs open into a feedback popup with message entry and animated sending, success and retry states.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: not-found-glitch
items.title: 404 / Not Found Glitch
items.description: Digits scramble through random glyphs before resolving, with a chromatic split on hover.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: not-found-magnetic
items.title: 404 / Not Found Magnetic
items.description: Each digit is cursor-attracted via the Magnetic wrapper and springs back on leave.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: not-found-spotlight
items.title: 404 / Not Found Spotlight
items.description: A dark panel where a cursor-tracked spotlight reveals the bright code from a dim base.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: not-found-stacked
items.title: 404 / Not Found Stacked
items.description: A code card over a hidden stack that fans out with a spring on hover.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>

items.name: not-found-terminal
items.title: 404 / Not Found Terminal
items.description: A terminal window that types a failed cd command and a 404 status, with a blinking caret.
items.author: kara <ztzyrant@gmail.com>
